hooks.command: P=$(cat); case "$P" in *'git commit'*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; [ -f "$R/agent-worker/run_tests.py" ] || exit 0; PY="$R/.venv/Scripts/python.exe"; [ -x "$PY" ] || PY="$R/.venv/bin/python"; [ -x "$PY" ] || PY=$(command -v python3 || command -v python) || exit 0; T="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/wt-precommit-$$-$RANDOM"; mkdir -p "$T" || exit 0; TO=$(command -v timeout || true); (cd "$R/agent-worker" && LOG_TO_FILE=0 SETTINGS_PATH="$T/s.json" SECRETS_PATH="$T/x.json" ADMIN_AUTH_PATH="$T/a.json" CALLS_PATH="$T/c" LISTENERS_PATH="$T/l.json" LISTENER_SAMPLE_INTERVAL=0 ${TO:+$TO 420} "$PY" run_tests.py >"$T/out.txt" 2>&1); S=$?; [ $S -eq 0 ] && { rm -rf "$T" 2>/dev/null; exit 0; }; "$PY" -c "import json,sys,pathlib;s=int(sys.argv[1]);out=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2]).read_text(errors='replace');bad=[l.strip() for l in out.splitlines() if l.startswith(('FAIL:','ERROR:'))][:6];slow=(s in (124,143));why=('The suite did not FINISH in 420s, which is a timeout rather than a failure - it runs in about a minute on an idle box. Something else is probably using the CPU (another test run, a build). Nothing here says the code is broken: re-run it yourself before believing this.') if slow else ('The suite is red, so this commit was blocked - CI runs the same suite before building an image, so it would not have shipped anyway.'+(chr(10)+chr(10)+chr(10).join(bad) if bad else ' No FAIL/ERROR lines were captured, which usually means it crashed on import - run it by hand to see.'));print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput':{'hookEventName':'PreToolUse','permissionDecision':'deny','permissionDecisionReason':why},'systemMessage':('Commit blocked: the suite timed out.' if slow else 'Commit blocked: the suite is failing.')}))" "$S" "$T/out.txt"; rm -rf "$T" 2>/dev/null

P=$(cat); case "$P" in *'git commit'*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; [ -f "$R/agent-worker/version.py" ] || exit 0; C=$(cd "$R" && git diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null); case "$P" in *' -a'*|*'--all'*) C="$C
$(cd "$R" && git diff --name-only 2>/dev/null)" ;; esac; printf '%s' "$C" | grep -qE '^(agent-worker|web-widget)/' || exit 0; printf '%s' "$C" | grep -q '^agent-worker/version\.py$' && exit 0; echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"This commit changes shipped code under agent-worker/ or web-widget/ but does not touch agent-worker/version.py. version.py exists so two containers running the same image can be told apart, and three commits in one afternoon shipped as duplicate versions because the bump was left to memory. Bump APP_VERSION and stage it, or if this genuinely ships nothing, say so and commit again with version.py untouched by removing the code change from the staged set."},"systemMessage":"Commit blocked: shipped code changed without bumping version.py."}'
